thread:
Alex: quick heads-up — I flipped the per-route v2 flag for tenant:falken and console still shows v1-preferred. Not sure if it's a UI cache or routing fallthrough.
Sam: did you check the routing debug header? `x-rw-route` vs `x-rw-client-version` could disagree.
Alex: I grabbed a trace: token routed to v2, but we returned fallback-to-v1 due to seqlen projection causing incompatible kv-cache plan. Console shows token -> v2 which is misleading.
Nina: could be our telemetry aggregation window — we only persist 'preferred_variant' from config, not 'effective_variant'. We should show both.
Beth: +1. UX request: console should display "Config preference / Effective routed model / Fallback reason" for the last 50 requests.
Sam: agree. Also we need quota attribution rules: if token claims v2 but ends up on v1 fallback, who gets billed? currently billed to the executed variant (v1) which skews tenant billing and makes usage-based alerts noisy.
Alex: For billing, I think we should bill to the original requested model for quota and to executed model for infra cost. That preserves tenant expectations while tracking infra delta.
Nina: that's messy but doable. Need to add two telemetry fields: `requested_model_tag` and `executed_model_tag` and a boolean `fallback_trigger`. Sampling at 1% for high-throughput routes until we validate.
Sam: we should also instrument a histogram of time-between-config-change-and-effective-shift. There's a weird 30s window where console toggles but routing still sticky.
DevOps-Bot: deploy queued: patch/eng-platform/console-effective-variant (PR #3127) — CI passed.
Beth: thanks bot. Alex / Sam — can one of you own the console copy/spec? I can do the visual mock once we settle fields.
Alex: I'll take the spec. Plan: add fields `requested_model_tag`, `effective_model_tag`, `fallback_reason` + sample stream for last 50 requests. Wire billing talk to finance for final signoff.
Sam: I'll add the telemetry metrics and a lightweight reconcile job that compares token attribution vs infra billing nightly. PR inbound.
Nina: for rollout UX, propose an orange 'deployed but sticky' indicator when config != effective for >10s. Also a console tooltip explaining quota attribution semantics.
Beth: perfect. Action items: Alex (spec + console copy), Sam (metrics + reconcile job), Nina (UX badge + tooltip), Beth (mock). Tagging @devops-bot to deploy once PRs merge.
Alex: one more note — keep the fallback ordering deterministic: variant pinned by token header -> tenant override -> global default. Document this in the spec, because ambiguous precedence caused a customer outage last month.
Sam: will add precedence table to PR. Also adding a guard: if fallback_reason == "kv-cache-mismatch" include `sequence_length_hint` in telemetry.
Nina: can we add a console query to show tenants with highest fallback-rate in last 24h? That'll help prioritize fixes.
Beth: yep, that's a dashboard tile. I'll add it to the deprec-dashboard group.
Alex: cool. If we agree, I'll open the console PR and link to Sam's metrics PR and Nina's mock.
Sam: sounds good. I'm going to enable 1% sampling on affected routes now so we have data for the mock.
Nina: thanks — will monitor.
DevOps-Bot: scheduled deploy: patch/eng-platform/console-effective-variant -> staging in 5m.
